[[Bogroot Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] obtained from the [[Bogroot Chest]], which appears after defeating [[Khabuus]] ([[Giriff's War]]) or [[Z'him Monns]] ([[Tekks's War]]) in [[Bogroot Growths]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +10
:[[Dark damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Restoration Magic]])
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:Halves casting time of [[Restoration Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +60
